name: application-sensor-reading-card
title: Sensor Reading Card
description: Live sensor reading tile (temperature, humidity, etc.) with a trend arrow and a threshold-derived "Out of range" alert computed live from a real min/max safe range, for smart-home or IoT dashboards.
useWhen: Showing a single live sensor reading (temperature, humidity, pressure) with a safe operating range.
You want the out-of-range alert computed from the real value against real thresholds, not a hand-set flag.
A trend arrow comparing against the previous reading adds useful context.
avoidWhen: You're showing multiple body-vital readings together — use vitals-stat-row instead.
There's no meaningful safe range to check against — use a plain stat-tile instead.
You need historical trend data, not just the latest reading — pair this card with a chart.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a single block sized to its content; place it in your own grid alongside other sensor cards for a dashboard layout.
accessibility: Out-of-range state is conveyed by both card background/border color and an explicit "Out of range" text badge, not color alone.
The safe range is always shown as visible text, giving context for why a reading is flagged.
Trend direction (warming/cooling or rising/falling) is conveyed by both an arrow icon and the signed delta value, not rotation alone.

variants.title: Sensor reading card
variants.description: Freezer temperature reading of 28°F against a 0–15°F safe range, shown in the out-of-range alert state with a warming trend, on a light surface.
accessibility: The out-of-range check (value < minSafe || value > maxSafe) is computed live, so the alert can never drift out of sync with the reading.

variants.title: Sensor reading card (Dark)
variants.description: The same out-of-range freezer reading, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Alert background, border, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
